THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

FILE
302

CONFIDENTIAL

Chinese Terrorist
Executed

Man Who Hurled Bombs on
July 7 Caught Visiting
Scenes of Exploit

Caught while revisiting the scene of
one of his alleged exploits, Chang
Yu-ho, 31, a Chinese convicted of ter-
rorism by a Japanese military court
martial, was executed yesterday,
Domei learned on good authority last
night.

Chang was seized by Sergeant Juro
Sakamoto of the water police section
of the Japanese Gendarmerie while
loitering near the Floating Restaurant
Pontoon, Peking Road and the Bund,
on the afternoon of July 7.

Under questioning, Chang is report-
ed having confessed that he was re-
sponsible for the two early morning
Bund bombings on July 7, the first
anniversary of the outbreak of the
Lukouchiao incident. One hand-
grenade exploded on the Floating Re-
staurant Pontoon, now being used as
the headquarters of the water police
section of the Japanese Gendarmerie,
another on the pavement in front
of the Yokohama Specie Bank. One
Chinese passer-by was killed by the
latter blast.

A native of Siusien, Kiangsu, Chang
was reported having said that he was
a member of a guerilla band opera-
ting on Tsungming Island.

Acting under orders from Hankow,
he boarded a steamer at Tsungming
on July 6, landing at Public Garden
Pontoon the same evening, he was
understood to have revealed.

Proceeding to the French Con-
cession, he was said to have secured
lodgings in the Rue du Marche. Two
days later, in company with an
undisclosed number of accomplices
he threw two hand grenades.

He was seized when he revisited
the scene of his morning "exploit."

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 18 AUG. 1933）

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 8 AUG. 1938）

DS. Kamoshita

inquire if the Japanese
Authorities of this news
is correct
yrs

DC Armie

enquiries at the military
Gendarmerie & was
informed by Lt. Major
KATODA that this news
is authentic and was given
out to the press by the
Gendarmerie
5.8.38.
Jno Robertson

《字林西报》，

档案
302

机密

中国恐怖分子
被处决

7月7日投掷炸弹者
在重访作案现场时被捕

据同盟社昨晚从可靠渠道获悉，31岁的中国人张玉和（Chang Yu-ho）昨日被处决。他此前被日本军事法庭以恐怖主义罪名定罪，并在重访其涉嫌作案的一处现场时被抓获。

7月7日下午，张玉和在南京路与外滩交界处的“浮宫”餐厅趸船附近徘徊时，被日本宪兵队水警部的坂本十郎（Juro Sakamoto）警佐逮捕。

据报道，张玉和在接受讯问时供认，他对7月7日凌晨在外滩发生的两起爆炸案负责，这一天恰是卢沟桥事变爆发一周年。一枚手榴弹在“浮宫”餐厅趸船上爆炸，该处现已被用作日本宪兵队水警部总部；另一枚在横滨正金银行门前的人行道上爆炸。后一起爆炸造成一名中国路人死亡。

据报道，张玉和称自己是江苏泗县人，系一支在崇明岛活动的游击队成员。

据其透露，他受汉口方面命令，于7月6日在崇明登船，当晚在公花园趸船登陆。

据说他随后前往法租界，在马当路（Rue du Marche）觅得住处。两天后，他与数量不明的同伙一起投掷了两枚手榴弹。

他在重访早晨“作案”现场时被抓获。

（印章：上海工部局总监办公室 1933年8月18日）

（印章：副总监 1938年8月8日）

DS. Kamoshita
请查询一下
日本当局关于此新闻
的说法是否属实
此致

DC Armie

并从片田（KATODA）少佐处获悉，
此消息属实，且由宪兵队
发布给新闻界
1938年8月5日。
Jno Robertson

Assistance to Japanese Military Police.

D.S. Bradley

At 4.30 a.m. July 11, 1938, D.S.I. Umemoto attached
to the S.P.O. accompanied representatives of the Japanese
and
Military Police to Crime Branch Headquarters/requested
assistance from C.S to visit No.32 Rue Canty, French Con-
cession, to investigate the statement of one Chang Nyoch
Woo (張玉和), 31, Kiangsu, who was arrested by the Japanese
Military Police on 7/7/38 in Pootung for being concerned in
a bomb outrage at the former Government Ferry, The Bund,
on the same date.

（批：- file D 8597）

Chang Nyoch Woo is a self confessed terrorist and he
made a statement to the Japanese Military Police to the
effect that one of his accomplices named Yang Mauh Ts (楊麻子)
was residing at No.32 Rue Canty and was in possession of a
bomb. Two other accomplices were also stated to be residing
in the Dah Woo Lodging House, 345 Avenue Edward VII, French
Concession.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 47 11 7 38）

D.S. Bradley, D.S.I. Chm, C.D.S. 100, D.S.I. Umemoto,
D.S. Mitsushima, D.S. Urums, and two representatives of the
Japanese Military Police accompanied by the prisoner Chang
Nyoch Woo proceeded to the French Concession at about 4.30 a.m.
and assistance to carry out investigations was rendered by
D.I. Henri.

The prisoner was then requested to lead the party to
address in which Yang Mauh Ts was residing and he led the
party not to Rue Canty, but to 409 Rue du Marche at which
add ress he insisted he had left Yang Mauh Ts and a bomb.

Enquiries elicited that the address visited was a
shelter for ricksha coolies and no one on the premises had

协助日本军警。

D.S. Bradley

1938年7月11日凌晨4时30分，隶属于上海警务处（S.P.O.）的日籍侦探长梅本（Umemoto）陪同日本军警代表前往刑事科总部，请求刑事科（C.S）提供协助，前往法租界康悌路（Rue Canty）32号，调查张玉和（Chang Nyoch Woo，31岁，江苏人）的供词。张于1938年7月7日在浦东因涉及同日发生在外滩前政府轮渡处的炸弹暴行而被日本军警逮捕。

（批注：- 归档 D 8597）

张玉和是一名自认的恐怖分子，他向日本军警作出供述，称其一名名为杨麻子（Yang Mauh Ts）的同伙居住在康悌路32号，并拥有一枚炸弹。另据称还有两名同伙居住在法租界爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）345号的大华旅舍（Dah Woo Lodging House）。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别科 47 11 7 38）

侦探长布拉德利（Bradley）、日籍侦探长陈（Chm）、华人侦探长100号、日籍侦探长梅本（Umemoto）、侦探长光岛（Mitsushima）、侦探长乌鲁姆斯（Urums）以及两名日本军警代表，在囚犯张玉和的陪同下，于凌晨4时30分左右前往法租界，侦探亨里（Henri）提供了协助以进行调查。

随后，囚犯被要求带领众人前往杨麻子的居住地，但他并未将众人带往康悌路，而是带到了马当路（Rue du Marche）409号，他坚称已将杨麻子和一枚炸弹留在此处。

经查询得知，该地址是一处人力车夫的收容所， premises 内无人
